
## Downloads

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows | `Chesswatch-…-Windows-Setup.exe` (installer) or `Chesswatch-…-Windows-portable.exe` (no install) |
| macOS | `Chesswatch-…-macOS.dmg` (Intel and Apple Silicon) |
| Linux | `Chesswatch-…-Linux-x86_64.AppImage` |
| iPhone / iPad | `Chesswatch-…-iOS-unsigned.ipa` (install with AltStore or Sideloadly) |
| Website | `Chesswatch-…-Web.zip` (host it anywhere) |

The apps are not code-signed, so your system will warn you the first time:

- **Windows:** "Windows protected your PC" → *More info* → *Run anyway*.
- **macOS:** right-click the app → *Open*. If macOS says the app is damaged, run `xattr -cr /Applications/Chesswatch.app` in Terminal.
- **iOS:** sign and install the IPA with [AltStore](https://altstore.io) or [Sideloadly](https://sideloadly.io) using your Apple ID.
